policy.windows_compatibility: Wine authorized; distinct from native Windows verification
policy.usage_monitoring: Native account-usage read is available; threshold checked for the active batch. Recheck at batch boundaries; do not infer unavailable windows.
policy.cloud_save_destination: Every completed section: commit and ordinary push origin codex/p2-development; full available validation after125 then every15 sections
policy.external_accuracy_sources: Actual public worked examples with URL, quoted inputs/outputs, version/applicability and explicit comparison; missing or mismatched conditions not PASS.
policy.validation_per_section: Necessary checks tied to changed behavior only; omit when unnecessary. Full available suite unchanged.
policy.section_definition: Before a section, bind a remaining todo, new capability and acceptance criteria. Pure bug fixes/tests/research/docs are maintenance and do not increment functional progress.

highest_priority_project_requirements.scope: Project-internal highest priority: check premises, exercise independent judgment, verify sources, explain disagreement and surface overlooked variables/costs/biases.

policy.player_readability: Default player output requires no computing terminology: useful result/information first, game Chinese names, conditions/units/unknowns explained; raw IDs, numeric implementation and debug details expandable.
